set.approach: From the Lake George parking area follow the west path around the lake, cross a stream, and take the climbers trail up the hillside, crossing the Crystal Lake outlet stream to a talus slope and the trees above it. Continue up the talus to the cliff, trending left toward the line of least resistance; a short fourth-class scramble gains sloping granite that is followed with care to the foot of the climbs. The route is on the right side of the wall, a little above the rappel station.
set.descent_text: Rappel bolts at the foot of the face give a faster and simpler way down than reversing the scramble that gained the base.

review.notes: Wall pages for approach and descent; route page for the start.

set.approach: Drive forest road 3N07, which runs along the fenceline, to its end where Parking Lot Rock is obvious; the crags in this area are a short trail hike from there. Coming from the south, reach South Prowler Rock past the northeast side of Lost Orbit Rock; coming from the north, go southeast from around Coyote Crag. The route starts in a chimney and corner, a short way right of George's Big Adventure.

review.notes: Area pages and route page ("lower off").

set.approach: Park at the junction of forest roads 2N13 and 2N13D, then hike uphill from the road, weaving through brush, to the southwest side of the formation. It lies on the right side of the main west-facing buttress.

review.notes: Area pages and route page.

set.approach: Park close to the dam and walk carefully to its south side; the north-facing wall is a short way along. Look for drill scars and the anchors at the top. The route is under the highest set of anchors; start directly below and go straight up.

review.notes: Area page and route page.

set.approach: Find Slide Dome in the Holcomb Valley Pinnacles and walk west from it for a few minutes to the northwest-facing wall. The route is the second one on the cliff, with a set of project anchors to its left.

review.notes: Area page and route page (route 6920 on the Sushi Bar wall, grade 5.11a matches).

set.approach: Hike up to the south face of the Rectory and continue east. The way in stays high past the Rectory south face, with some second-class ground up toward the Rectory east face and past the Convent and Mosque notch; the brush is thick and the way is not obvious. The route has bolts right of the chimney that is right of Mazel Tov!.

review.notes: Area page and route page.

set.approach: From the north shore of Big Bear Lake, park where Greenway Drive meets Pioneer Lane and take the trails that wander up the hillside; the formations sit on the south-facing slope above. Table Top Rock is a hike uphill and west from Secret Spot Rock. The route is on the left side of the south face.

review.notes: Area pages and route page.

set.approach: Park in the northwest-facing turnout on the north side of forest road 3N16, east of Holcomb Valley Campground. The slab is visible from the road a short walk to the north. The route is above and slightly right of the main slab.

review.notes: Area page and route page. Stored pitches 0 flagged.

set.approach: Hike to the Church Domes. Temple of Doom is beyond the huge Mosque and Tower of Babel faces: scramble up the pass past them, then go east and south to the south face of a crag built of three towers. The route climbs the southeast arete of the West Tower, right of Black Jesus.

review.notes: Area pages and route page ("lower off").

set.approach: Take the trail toward Dragonlance Wall and Voodoo Wall over the first ridge and across the seasonal creek. The Addams Family slab appears on your left roughly midway up the approach gully. The route is the only bolted line, in the center of the slab.

review.notes: Area page and route page both state a walk-off.

set.approach: Drive forest road 3N07 to its end at Parking Lot Rock, then follow the trail that wraps around the north side of that rock and heads north to Two Tree Rock. The route is on the west side and starts as Epic Zedu does, finishing up and right.

review.notes: Area pages and route page.
